description: X-TAIL results (CLIP ViT-B/16 unless noted, RAIL's single prompt). 'settings': the final run on held-out seeds 16-20, where ml_rail_gate_reverse_cls10 is the reported method and ml_rail_gate_reverse the earlier full-kernel reverse gate; 'run_seeds_11_15': the held-out run of the full-kernel reverse gate; 'replication_seeds_6_10': the first held-out run (no reverse gate). table[t][d] is the accuracy (%) on domain d after learning domains 0..t; Transfer/Average/Last as in RAIL's code. The tuning protocol and gate sensitivity checks use seeds 6-10; the Transfer headroom and take-back signal analyses use development seeds 1-5 and validation. 'vitl14_seeds_16_20': CLIP ViT-L/14 with every setting kept from ViT-B/16 (plus RAIL at the kernel width ViT-L/14's validation prefers).
